questions.q: What is the approximate pH of a salt solution formed from a strong acid and a strong base?
options: Can be less than or greater than 7 depending on temperature
questions.explain: A salt formed by the neutralization of a strong acid and a strong base results in a neutral solution. The pH of a neutral solution is exactly 7.
